import { expect } from "chai";
import { ethers } from "hardhat";

describe("StaxLPStaking - Kill mutant m1b3d474b (>= instead of >)", function () {
  it("should NOT emit RewardPaid event when claimable reward is zero", async function () {
    const [owner, user] = await ethers.getSigners();
    
    // Deploy a mock ERC20 token for staking
    const MockERC20 = await ethers.getContractFactory("MockERC20");
    const stakingToken = await MockERC20.deploy("Staking Token", "STK", ethers.parseEther("1000000"));
    await stakingToken.waitForDeployment();
    
    // Deploy a mock ERC20 token for rewards
    const rewardToken = await MockERC20.deploy("Reward Token", "RWD", ethers.parseEther("1000000"));
    await rewardToken.waitForDeployment();
    
    // Deploy StaxLPStaking
    const Factory = await ethers.getContractFactory("StaxLPStaking");
    const instance = await Factory.deploy(await stakingToken.getAddress(), owner.address);
    await instance.waitForDeployment();
    
    // Add reward token
    await instance.addReward(await rewardToken.getAddress());
    
    // Transfer some reward tokens to owner and notify reward
    await rewardToken.transfer(owner.address, ethers.parseEther("1000"));
    await rewardToken.connect(owner).approve(await instance.getAddress(), ethers.parseEther("1000"));
    await instance.connect(owner).notifyRewardAmount(await rewardToken.getAddress(), ethers.parseEther("1000"));
    
    // User stakes some tokens
    await stakingToken.transfer(user.address, ethers.parseEther("100"));
    await stakingToken.connect(user).approve(await instance.getAddress(), ethers.parseEther("100"));
    await instance.connect(user).stake(ethers.parseEther("100"));
    
    // Wait for some time to accrue rewards
    await ethers.provider.send("evm_increaseTime", [3600]); // 1 hour
    await ethers.provider.send("evm_mine", []);
    
    // Now withdraw all and claim rewards - this should trigger _getReward
    // The user has earned rewards, so we need a scenario where claimable is exactly 0
    
    // Alternative approach: Create a user who never stakes (balance = 0)
    // Their claimable reward will always be 0
    
    const [_, addr1, addr2] = await ethers.getSigners();
    
    // addr2 never stakes, so their earned() should be 0
    // Call getReward for addr2 with no stake - should NOT emit RewardPaid
    
    // First, let's verify earned is 0
    const earnedAmount = await instance.earned(addr2.address, await rewardToken.getAddress());
    expect(earnedAmount).to.equal(0);
    
    // Now call getReward - the mutant would emit RewardPaid for amount 0
    // The original should NOT emit any event
    const tx = await instance.connect(addr2).getReward(addr2.address, await rewardToken.getAddress());
    const receipt = await tx.wait();
    
    // Check that no RewardPaid event was emitted
    const rewardPaidEvents = receipt.logs.filter(
      (log: any) => {
        try {
          const parsed = instance.interface.parseLog({ topics: log.topics as string[], data: log.data });
          return parsed?.name === "RewardPaid";
        } catch {
          return false;
        }
      }
    );
    
    expect(rewardPaidEvents.length).to.equal(0, "Should not emit RewardPaid when claimable reward is zero");
  });
});
